blocks.text: The gene ***BRCA1*** (also known as *breast cancer type 1*) is located on chromosome 17. The protein product, **BRCA1**, acts as a tumor suppressor.
As discussed in *The Emperor of All Maladies* by Siddhartha Mukherjee, and *The Gene: An Intimate History*, the understanding of cancer genetics has evolved dramatically.
The **p53** pathway regulates apoptosis. Mutations in TP53 (now called **TP53**) are found in ~50% of cancers.
